new_packages.label: פָּנִים וֶאֱמֶת
new_packages.label_en: Face and Truth — The Tzaddik's Transmitted Identity
supporting_bechinas: אמת = פנים (line 4: 'truth IS the face of all faces of holiness' — with proofs from Psalms 24:6 and Micah 7:20 via Jacob)
פנים = דמות דיוקנו (lines 2, 5, 9-10: the tzaddik's 'face' IS his transmitted image, which is engraved in the student's mind and in the book's letters)
דמות דיוקנו = דיו (lines 16-17: 'what is imprinted as the image of the teacher is the bechina of ink'; wordplay דַּיּוֹ לְעֶבֶד = דְּיוֹ ink)
new_packages.reason: These four concepts all share the same essential nature: the expressible, transmittable face of the tzaddik's inner essence. Truth (אמת) IS the face (פנים) of holiness — the external expression of the tzaddik's inner reality. When the student receives the tzaddik's true speech, the tzaddik's 'image' (דמות דיוקנו) — which is the same as his face — is engraved in the student's mind. This image IS 'ink' (דיו): a real but lower-level reflection, the lowest level of the tzaddik's consciousness that can cross to the student. All four concepts describe the same phenomenon from different angles: the transmittable-face-of-the-tzaddik as distinct from his full inner being (which cannot be transmitted, only his raglayim/feet). This is an independent domain from Package 1 (soul/intellect) — Package 1 describes WHAT is transmitted (the tzaddik's inner essence), while this proposed package describes HOW it appears to the receiver (as a face, as truth, as an image, as ink on paper).
new_packages.domain: The phenomenology of tzaddik-to-student transmission: the received image
new_packages.threshold_met: Yes — 4 nodes with 3 explicit bechina equations in the source text, forming an independent conceptual domain.

new_packages.label: מוֹחִין וְאֵשׁ
new_packages.label_en: Mind-Forces and Fire — The Metaphysical Substrate of Transmission
proposed_nodes: אש שחורה על גבי אש לבנה
supporting_bechinas: אש שחורה על גבי אש לבנה = מוחין (line 20: explicit — 'this is the bechina of mochin')
לבנון = מוחין (line 20, via Zohar Pinchas 235b: 'streams from Lebanon = from the whiteness of the brain — לבונה דמוחא')

שחורה אני ונאוה = אש שחורה על גבי אש לבנה (line 20: both are stated consecutively as expressing the same principle of lower-level transmission within a hierarchical structure — what is dark/low from the perspective of the higher is luminous from the perspective of the lower)
new_packages.reason: These four concepts share the essential nature of the metaphysical substrate of the transmission process — the realm of mochin (higher consciousness-forces) that underlies the entire teaching. The teaching's final section (lines 17-20) introduces a universal principle: 'כָּל הַהִתְלַבְּשׁוּת שֶׁמִּתְלַבֵּשׁ דַּרְגָּא בְּדַרְגָּא — when level clothes itself in level, only the last sub-level of the higher descends.' This principle is illustrated through black fire on white fire (the Yerushalmi: Torah = black letters on white parchment = lower-level mochin descending onto higher-level mochin), Lebanon = whiteness of brain (the luminous source that streams down), and 'black yet beautiful' (Song of Songs 1:5 — the black/descended level is still lofty relative to what receives it). These are all expressions of the same structural reality: the mochin-transmission principle. Polarity is neutral because these are structural/metaphysical objects (fire, mountains, biblical images) that describe the architecture of transmission rather than aligning specifically with holiness or evil.
new_packages.domain: The architecture of inter-level transmission: mochin, fire-imagery, the principle of raglayim
new_packages.threshold_met: Yes — 4 nodes with 3 explicit bechina equations in the source text, forming an independent structural/metaphysical domain.

new_packages.label: לּוֹמֵד יֶלֶד וְלּוֹמֵד זָקֵן
new_packages.label_en: The Young Learner and the Old Learner — Two Modes of Reception
supporting_bechinas: לומד ילד = נייר חדש (lines 12-13: 'the student who hears directly at the moment of novella IS the bechina of yeled / like ink written on new paper, clearly engraved without smudging')
לומד זקן = נייר מחוק (line 14: 'then he is the bechina of zaken as he was before, and is like ink written on erased/smudged paper')
new_packages.reason: These four concepts form a paired antithetical structure: the two modes of receiving Torah from a teacher, each equated with a writing material. לומד ילד (learning as a child — hearing directly from the sage at the moment of novella, when the souls undergo ibbur/spiritual renewal) IS 'new parchment' — the impression is clear. לומד זקן (learning as an elder — hearing later, without the soul-renewal of ibbur) IS 'erased parchment' — the impression is smudged and susceptible to forgetting. These are bechina equations (not cause-and-effect): the TYPE of learner IS the TYPE of parchment — they share the same essential quality of receptivity/impermeability. While the polarity is slightly positive (ילד) and negative (זקן), the pair together is a neutral structural contrast — two modes of the same transmission process, neither purely evil (זקן is deficient, not evil). All four concepts belong to the domain of learning modalities and memory.
new_packages.domain: The two modes of reception: direct transmission (ילד/new paper) vs. secondary transmission (זקן/old paper)
new_packages.threshold_met: Borderline — 4 nodes but only 2 explicit bechina equations (one per pair). However, since the two pairs are structurally antithetical and inseparable as a teaching unit (the Rebbe introduces them together via the Avot saying in line 12), they form one coherent package. Alternatively, each pair could remain a 2-node isolated component if the threshold for new packages is strictly 3+ connected nodes.

observations:
Torah #192 is a teaching about transmission of wisdom from tzaddik to student through true speech. With only 1 bechina edge in the current dataset (נשמה ↔ חכמה), the existing bechina graph is drastically incomplete. The source text contains approximately 7-9 explicit bechina equations organized around 3 distinct conceptual domains beyond the existing Package 1:

(1) The face-truth-image cluster (proposed Package 192-A): how the tzaddik's identity appears to the receiver — as face, truth, portrait, ink. This is the most important missing cluster, as it underlies the teaching's central claim (the student receives the tzaddik's face-intellect-soul as a unified transmission).

(2) The mochin-fire cluster (proposed Package 192-B): the metaphysical architecture of how higher consciousness descends into lower levels — black fire on white fire, Lebanon/brain-whiteness, 'black yet beautiful.' This is the theoretical underpinning of WHY only the lowest sub-level of the tzaddik is received (his speech/dibur = raglayim of his consciousness).

(3) The ילד/זקן learning modes cluster (proposed Package 192-C): the practical distinction between two modes of receiving Torah, using the parchment metaphor. This maps directly to the Avot saying and the Mishnaic chain (Avot 4, Hagigah 9b) the Rebbe is explicating.

If the bechina edges identified in torah_192_additions.json were added to the dataset, the Torah would yield approximately 4 packages from ~9 bechina edges and ~12 nodes — a more complete representation of its conceptual structure. The existing eitza edges (זכרון → זוכה להיות כרבו; חזר מאה ואחת → זוכר) would then function as causal connections BETWEEN packages, representing the practical advice that flows from the conceptual framework.
